title: MD-S020-R0067 proved through the alias ownership chain; MD-B01 reaches 207/207
attempt_outcome: COMPLETE — the last MD-B01 rule is proven by execution and the stage closes at full coverage

authority_basis.fingerprint_recomputation: sha1 recomputed across all 6490 rows after binding; 0 mismatches

runtime_artifact_boundary.basis: The predicate is a property of four strategy documents and one decision record. No runtime artifact is required or claimed.

baseline.pre_change_state: MD-B01 at 206/207 with MD-S020-R0067 the single NOT_ASSESSED row, blocked by F-MD-B01-A003-001 and MD-DEP-0005.

what_the_decision_did_and_did_not_do.did: D-MD-20260822-04 established that R0067's obligation is discharged for CONSUMER_READ_CONTRACT_LOCKED.md through canonical semantic ownership plus that document's own explicit delegation of field semantics.
what_the_decision_did_and_did_not_do.did_not: It did not mark the rule SATISFIED. A decision settles how an obligation may be discharged; it is not proof that the discharge holds. This attempt supplies the proof.
what_the_decision_did_and_did_not_do.not_relied_upon: MD-S020-R0189 is not the operative instrument. Its condition is a dependent document that conflates eligibility with readability or policy, and CONSUMER_READ_CONTRACT_LOCKED.md does the opposite — its sentence exists to separate them. Declaring R0189's interim precedence permanent would also strain the word 'until', which anticipates an update rather than excusing one.

proof.shape: The predicate is a chain, so each link is asserted separately rather than end-to-end. A chain proven only end-to-end stays green while an intermediate document quietly drops the sentence carrying it.

links.claim: the canonical owner registers the term and states the alias meaning
links.asserted: the Term ownership register exists, claims `eligibility snapshot` under Dimensi fakta, and the document states that a compatibility field named `eligible` has only the upstream data-usability meaning

links.claim: the document that names the alias delegates field semantics
links.asserted: consumers read only the versioned read model defined by Downstream_Consumer_Read_Model_Contract_LOCKED.md; the reviewed sentence naming `eligible = 1` is still present; and the document still does not state the meaning itself, so a future change there reopens the decision rather than silently outgrowing it

links.claim: the delegated contract states the meaning in full
links.asserted: the alias means data_usable; it is not watchlist selection, tradability approval, alpha, ranking, or portfolio policy; and it does not by itself prove the requested publication is readable — the same caveat the readiness contract restates

links.claim: the owner boundary closes the chain
links.asserted: the Required cross-contract alignment section names both the delegated contract and the term owner, so the linkage is required by the owner rather than by the decision relying on it

links.claim: the governing decision remains present and scope-limited
links.asserted: status ISSUED, strategy impact NONE, the Scope limit section intact, and the statement that no strategy revision was authorised or required

proof.load_bearing_check: test_each_link_is_individually_load_bearing removes each link from a copy of its document text and asserts the removal lands and takes the link with it, so no link can rot unnoticed.

test_execution.gates: All six PASS: documentation integrity, relationship integrity, classification consistency, traceability applicability, scope boundary completion, promoted predicate proof.

negative_and_fail_closed_proof.method: Each mutation asserted to have landed before the guard was judged; strategy documents restored from pre-mutation copies and confirmed byte-identical by git.
mutations: the delegated contract drops `A compatibility \`eligible\` field means \`data_usable\`` -> link 3 failed (landed, count=1)
the decision loses its Scope limit heading -> link 5 failed (landed, count=1)
negative_and_fail_closed_proof.restoration_verified: git reports no change under authority/strategy/; the suite re-executed green.

guard_self_correction.event: The first full-suite run after the decision was written failed DualUseFactAndContractAlignmentTest: the decision record quoted the tradability misreading it exists to deny, and the guard read the quotation as an assertion.
guard_self_correction.resolution: The sentence was rewritten to refer to the misreading rather than reproduce it. No exemption was added. This is the seventh occurrence of a guard flagging a document that is honouring the rule, and the rule for handling it has not changed: rewrite the document, never carve out the guard.

traceability_effect.before: NOT_ASSESSED, no evidence, blocked by F-MD-B01-A003-001
traceability_effect.after: SATISFIED, bound to E-MD-B01-A016-001, governing_decision=D-MD-20260822-04 recorded in the row note
traceability_effect.gate_locks_updated: MarketDataScopeBoundaryCompletionGate and MarketDataPromotedPredicateProofGate carried a blocked-rule invariant requiring R0067 to stay NOT_ASSESSED. Both now require the opposite — that it stays SATISFIED and stays bound to E-MD-B01-A016-001 — so a regression or a misbinding fails closed. Both self-tests were updated and re-executed.

checked: No strategy byte changed; git reports authority/strategy/ clean after all mutations were restored.
No semantic requirement was duplicated into a non-owner document — the outcome the decision explicitly rejected.
No gate lock was left asserting the pre-decision state; both were inverted and mutation-proven.
The rule is bound to the attempt that proved it, not to the decision that unblocked it.
The decision record was rewritten rather than exempted when a guard flagged it.
